mapper.select: SELECT lifecycle.tenant_id, lifecycle.tenant_code, lifecycle.display_name, lifecycle.status, lifecycle.version, lifecycle.created_at, COALESCE(MAX(outbox.occurred_at), lifecycle.created_at) AS last_changed_at FROM organization_access.tenant_lifecycle lifecycle LEFT JOIN organization_access.tenant_lifecycle_outbox outbox ON outbox.tenant_id = lifecycle.tenant_id GROUP BY lifecycle.tenant_id, lifecycle.tenant_code, lifecycle.display_name, lifecycle.status, lifecycle.version, lifecycle.created_at ORDER BY last_changed_at DESC, lifecycle.tenant_id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
